item.name: Login with unknown user gives the same 401

exec: pm.test('same message as a wrong password (no account enumeration)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql('Invalid username/email or password'));
pm.test('newest first', () => { const t = body.messages.map((m) => new Date(m.timestamp).getTime()); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });

item.name: Get DM history, page size 1 has a next page

exec: pm.test('one message and nextPage 2', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.messages).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.nextPage).to.eql(2); });

description.content: A DM conversation that dmUser is in (from npm run seed:dm)

REST API from SAD 3.2.1 (Test Plan §8, CS-14 / CS-35). Socket.IO events are documented in docs/API.md.

Run everything automatically (starts a server, seeds a DM, runs this collection, saves results): `cd server && npm run postman`.

Manual run: start the server, run `npm run seed:dm` in server/ and copy the printed conversationId / dmUser / dmPassword into the collection variables, then run the collection.
